blocks.x: I'm John Fuhannes. I'm from Minneapolis, University of Minnesota.
And we're here at the New Orleans Hotel, talking to Armin Hug, pianist from New Orleans. Is that your real name? And Dick Allen of the New Orleans Archives. Armin, is that your real name, Armin Hug?
Yes, that's from my real name. Armin Hug, that's right. And you didn't ask me where I was born at.
No, I never have known your full name.
Oh, Dick, please. Don't tell me. Armin, Oscar Hug. Okay.
You know, I never have known the Oscar.
Yeah, well, that's neat, isn't it?
To use a modern expression. Yeah.
Okay. Yeah. And my name's Dick Allen. That's what I've got to say. I didn't know.
And my good friend, Mr. Henry Fuhidu, just passed through.

Okay. You can tell us all about him. He can tell us all about Bump John or something. Okay. Well, take over, John. I'll move the microphones back. I didn't want to interrupt. Just open up to the track.
